info.title: Ravenna API
info.description:
The Ravenna API is a RESTful web service add on that gives your school the option of connecting directly to your ADMIT data to use in other school systems.

The API is accessed by generating an API key in ADMIT. Once generated this key can be used to connect to the API by including Authorization: apikey header.

The base URL is www.ravenna-admit.com

Additional documentation is available directly through the API at www.ravenna-admit.com/api/v1/meta
info.x-implementation-details-body:
Authorization is performed using a supplied api_key. Inlcude the key the request header in the format: Authorization: apikey

Endpoints are named using object/id URL format. Requests that end with an object generally return a list/array of objects, while requests that end in a specific id return only that object.

Basic structure

SSL/TLS is required. The API will return a status code of 426 Upgrade Required on all non-SSL/TLS requests.

All resource lists will be paginated. The parameters are page and per_page. By default, page=1 and per_page=100. The HTTP header X-Total-Count will return the total number of matching resources.

Each user/token's access to the API is rate limited. On each request, the following headers track the rate limiting information:

  • X-Rate-Limit-Limit - The number of allowed requests in the current period
  • X-Rate-Limit-Remaining - The number of remaining requests in the current period
  • X-Rate-Limit-Reset - The number of seconds left in the current period
The initial rate limit shall be 1000 requests/300 seconds. This may be adjusted if legitimate users frequently hit the limit. Upon reaching the limit, the API will return a status code of 429 Too Many Requests until the current period elapses.

Conventions

All dates/times are UTC and ISO 8601 format (YYYY-mm-dd HH:ii:ss)

Object Descriptions:

All returned objects are in JSON format. These object descriptions are not yet finalized. Fields may be added or removed in the near future. For the most up-to-date object descriptions, please use the EXPLAIN verb on the endpoint in question.

Optional Parameters

The following optional query parameters can be passed.

  • fieldList: Comma separated list of fields that will be returned in the json instead of the full object. For example, to retrieve a list of only application ids you could use api/v1/applicants?fieldList=id

Error

Describes the error that has just occurred. Returned for all 4xx status codes, and as many 50x status codes as possible.

Application.description: Provides access to the applications table and related data

created.description: (read-only)date and time (UTC) that this record was created

modified.description: date and time this record was last updated

student_modified.description: date and time the related student record was last updated

full_application_modified.description: date and time the latest change to the application or related records. This includes changes to the application, student, household, steps, siblings, form submissions, custom field answers, test scores, or financial aid apps

root_application_id.description: (optional) ID of the master application record, if this record is a subordinate

admission_year.description: (optional) ID of the master application record, if this record is a subordinate

name_familiar.description: (optional) applicant's common/nick name if different from first name

dateset_id.description: ID of the dateset(application type) this applicant is using

is_international.description: True if applicant has self-selected as being an international applicant.

apply_grade.description: (read-only in API) grade the applicant is applying to (set by parent)

apply_grade_override.description: grade the applicant is applying to, if different than apply_grade (set by school)

current_grade.description: (read-only in API) the applicant's current grade (set by parent)

application_status.description: Overall status of the application. Currently one of (exploring, started, applied, formsComplete, complete) May expand in the future

internal_status.description: Status of the applicant in school's internal process. currently one of (notReady, reading, decisions, done, printed). May expand in the future.

current_school_id.description: id of the School object where this applicant currently attends school

current_school_name.description: name of the school this applicant currently attends (may be set if current_school_id is null)

is_matriculating.description: true if this applicant will be enrolled in the future

is_sibling.description: true if this applicant is a sibling of a current student

is_legacy.description: true if this applicant is related to an important alumnum

is_board.description: true if the applicant is related to a current board member

is_faculty.description: true if the applicant is related to a current faculty/staff member

is_boarding.description: true if the applicant is applying for boarding, false if day-only

is_fa.description: true if the applicant is or will be applying for financial aid
